description: Precautionary patterns for a Word native equation to MathType conversion workflow. Warnings are not universal LaTeX errors.

rules.message: Multi-line LaTeX environments may not survive this conversion workflow; split the expression and verify it manually.
Explicit spacing commands can become placeholders during conversion; prefer ordinary separators where mathematically appropriate.
This layout command has caused compatibility problems in some Word-to-MathType workflows; verify the converted formula.
Automatic delimiter sizing is accepted by LaTeX but should be conversion-tested in Word and MathType.
Text-oriented formula commands can be interpreted differently by equation converters; verify the result.
